search.query: index=main sourcetype=aria_pipeline event_type=rca_complete | stats dc(root_cause) as count
index=main sourcetype=aria_pipeline event_type=rca_complete | stats avg(confidence_score) as c | eval pct=round(c*100,1) | fields pct
index=main sourcetype=aria_pipeline event_type=rca_complete | stats avg(causal_chain_length) as d | eval d=round(d,1) | fields d

index=main sourcetype=aria_pipeline event_type=rca_complete | eval conf=round(confidence_score*100,1)."%" | table _time incident_id root_cause conf causal_chain counterfactual_scenario | rename _time as Time, incident_id as Incident, root_cause as "Root Cause", conf as Confidence, causal_chain as "Causal Chain", counterfactual_scenario as "Counterfactual: What if?" | sort -Time | head 20
index=main sourcetype=aria_pipeline event_type=rca_complete | stats count by root_cause | sort -count | head 10
